full_judgment:
3. The Government-defendant No. 35 and defendant Nos. 49-51 contested the suit by filing two separate written statements. The case of the Government is that the plaintiffs previously filed Title Suit No. 44 of 1984 in respect of the same suit property for permanent injunction by admitting the suit land to be the land in the khas khatian of the Government and the Govt. agreed to give lease of the suit land to him. In that suit, the plaintiff got temporary 

 injunction and the Government filed Miscellaneous Appeal NO. 14 of 1987 and the order of temporary injunction was vacated. Knowing full well that the suit land is the khas land of the Government and recorded in the Government khas khatian plaintiffs falsely filed the present suit.
